title: Sources: Google, Meta, Netflix, Microsoft, and Amazon will not be included in the EU's Digital Networks Act, despite calls from telecoms companies (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
summary: Foo Yun Chee / Reuters: Sources: Google, Meta, Netflix, Microsoft, and Amazon will not be included in the EU's Digital Networks Act, despite calls from telecoms companies — Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O), Meta Platforms (META.O), Netflix (NFLX.O), Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Amazon (AMZN.O) will not face heavy-handed regulations …
